expected.scene_file_digest_scope: scene XML file digest from the native file manifest; not observable through native HTTP
expected.config_manifest_scope: sha256 of canonical JSON covering the YAML extends-chain bytes, the effective post-override config, and the profile/arm_spec bytes actually read; source code and installed packages are outside this digest and are reported separately
expected.scene_manifest_scope: sha256 of canonical JSON of the served /api/v1/scene compiled manifest (links, geoms, mesh hashes, cameras, tcp_site); the source XML digest is a separate declaration and not a substitute

native.manifest_digest_format: sha256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(files, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon)), without newline

verification.runtime_environment: not checked at platform startup; native runtime_package_versions is checked at readiness

limitations: Preset, dependency and model identity are local expectations; native HTTP does not attest the deployed source tree
The pinned scene digest covers the scene XML file only, not the compiled scene manifest served by the running process
The requirements lock is verified as a pinned release file, not read from the live native environment
Runtime package versions are a native self-report and are checked against the lock; they are not a platform-side environment inspection
Kinematics constants come from source files, not from a native capability endpoint
